title: FileNodeContribution
description: A node in the repository tree (file, directory, symlink) with co-located static metrics and last-touching git commit. Pattern-C universal slot. Producers (techno-specific KSs, see Rule 1): `FileKS` today; future per-language scanners may enrich `metrics` and `language`. One contribution per discovered path.

producerKind.description: Pattern-C discriminator (§8bis Rule 2). Open enum tagging the producer techno that emitted this record.

language.description: Detected source language (files only). Per-file; repo-wide histogram is a client-side reduction over this slot.

metrics.description: Static file-level metrics (files only). Optional; populated when computable.

lastCommit.description: Most recent git commit that touched this path (files only).

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). Producer-specific fields that don't fit the universal core. Tool-agnostic consumers ignore.
